Name: Seasonal outfits - SCA Style for Rasmodia (RRRR patch compatible)
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
First mod in pixel art made by yours truly with the help of Nom0ri, the original creator of Rasmodia!

Ever thought it was a shame Rasmodia only had RGB for her seasonals? Then you'll probably like, or at least I hope, this! I'm making a seasonal mod for Rasmodia, giving her outfits for every season and festival, with extra hairstyles included!

This mod includes:
[list]
[*]Seasonal outfits for Rasmodia, with hatless versions included[/*]
[*]Festival outfits, one for every festival SCA has[/*]
[*]12 types of hairstyles for Rasmodia, with multiple configurations[/*]
[*]New earrings for RRRR that can be used even without having RRRR installed[/*]
[/list]
This mod has HD Wedding Reception portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]﻿! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/TPHbdRkt/Options.png[/img]
﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/k46bDkzq/Hairstyles.png[/img]
[spoiler]All hairstyles available
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sx4bW0G0/Rasmodia-Hairstyles1.png[/img][/spoiler]
[u][i][b]Seasonal Hairs[/b]
[/i][/u]Hairstyle can be changed by season, by default the hairstyles go in this order:
[list]
[*][b]Spring:[/b] Short[/*]
[*][b]Summer:[/b] Short Shorter[/*]
[*][b]Fall:[/b] Medium[/*]
[*][b]Winter:[/b] Long[/*]
[/list]Hairstyles can also be changed randomly to any hairstyle or to a specific lenght each season[i][u]
[b]Randomize Hair Styles
[/b][/u][/i]Changes Rasmodia's hairstyle each day, it can be set to any hairstyle or to a specific lenght to choose from. This overrides [b]Seasonal hairs[/b]

[i][b][u]Hairstyle Override
[/u][/b][/i]Sets Rasmodia's hairstyle to always have a specific hairstyle
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/y88Xsr1Y/outfits.png[/img]
[i][u][b]Rasmodia Hat On
[/b][/u][/i]Changes Rasmodia's portraits and sprites to a hatless version. It can be set to always, never, only outside or only inside
﻿
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0QmTkNkv/Rasmodia-Seasons.png[/img]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J0L9GW0k/Rasmodia-festival-Hatless.png[/img][/spoiler]

[i][u][b]Festival outfits[/b][/u][/i]
Enables outfits for the festivals

[i][u][b]Summer gloves
[/b][/u][/i]Adds gloves to the summer outfit, so it fits with its concept art

[i][u][b]Winter outdoor cape
[/b][/u][/i]Enables the cape for Rasmodia when she is outside in winter
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L8QkXB5k/Extra.png[/img]
[i][u][b]Rasmodia scars
[/b][/u][/i]﻿Adds scars to Rasmodia's portraits, can only been seen when RRRR is downloaded

[i][u][b]Rasmodia earrings
[/b][/u][/i]Adds earrings to Rasmodia's portraits and sprites, best suited with RRRR but can be seen even without it.


[u][i]Steamdeck sliders: (only in the optional file)[/i][/u]
